description: This file defines the DepositAccountRecurringDetail class, which encapsulates the details of recurring deposit accounts in the Fineract project. It includes fields for deposit amounts, overdue details, inheritance flags, and links to the associated savings account. It provides methods for creating, updating, and copying instances, as well as handling validation and business logic specific to recurring deposits.

classes.name: DepositAccountRecurringDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing detailed recurring deposit account information, including deposit amounts, overdue status, inheritance flags, and linked account data.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new DepositAccountRecurringDetail with specified deposit amount, details, account, and inheritance flag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates deposit details based on a JSON command, returning the map of changes.

methods.name: updateMandatoryRecommendedDepositAmount
methods.description: Updates the mandatory deposit amount, validates account status, and refreshes related schedule and maturity details.

methods.name: updateAccountReference
methods.description: Sets or updates the associated savings account reference.

methods.name: isMandatoryDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the deposit is mandatory based on recurring details.

methods.name: allowWithdrawal
methods.description: Determines if withdrawal is allowed based on recurring details.

methods.name: adjustAdvanceTowardsFuturePayments
methods.description: Checks if advance payments towards future installments are allowed.

methods.name: mandatoryRecommendedDepositAmount
methods.description: Getter for the recommended deposit amount.

methods.name: isCalendarInherited
methods.description: Returns whether the calendar settings are inherited.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current instance, including recurring details.

methods.name: updateOverdueDetails
methods.description: Updates overdue installment count and total overdue amount.
